//: Three profiles, and the one you want for a phone is `preview`.
`preview` produces an .apk you download and install directly. `production`
produces an .aab, which is the Play Store upload format and CANNOT be
installed on a phone — asking for one and then trying to install it is the
EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL is baked in AT BUILD TIME. An APK built against a laptop's
LAN address stops working the moment that address changes, which it does every
time the router hands out a new lease. That is fine for an afternoon of testing
and wrong for anything you hand to a school.
